job.title: Team Lead, Software Development (Backend)- all genders

tailoring.headline: Software Development Team Lead & Senior Java Developer | SAP Commerce Cloud
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms and microservices for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, SQL, and database performance tuning. Proven background in technical leadership, code reviews, and mentoring junior developers within agile teams. Experienced in collaborating with product managers, architects, and international stakeholders to deliver scalable applications and drive operational excellence. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Team Lead, Software Development (Backend)
cover_en.hook: Bringing over 5 years of backend engineering expertise and technical leadership from Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am thrilled to apply for the Team Lead, Software Development role at Lightspeed. I am inspired by your mission to streamline operations for businesses worldwide through robust point-of-sale solutions and high-performing development teams.

bullets.label: Technical Leadership & Mentoring
bullets.text: Performed code reviews, supported production issues, and provided technical guidance and mentoring to junior developers across international teams.

bullets.label: Scalable Microservices & Backend Development
bullets.text: Designed and implemented robust backend functionality and RESTful APIs using Java and Spring Boot, ensuring high technical quality and performant applications.

bullets.label: Cross-Functional Collaboration
bullets.text: Collaborated closely with business stakeholders, product owners, and technical teams to analyze requirements, translate them into scalable solutions, and drive project delivery.

bullets.label: Operational Excellence & Delivery
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles on cloud portals, optimized database performance, and led query refactoring to improve transaction speed and system stability.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe with a valid German work permit, I am serving a notice period ending 15 December 2026, with an earliest start date of 16 December 2026. I welcome the opportunity to discuss how my technical leadership and backend experience align with Lightspeed's goals.

tailoring.why_company: I want to lead and grow software development teams at Lightspeed because your mission to empower businesses worldwide with robust platform solutions aligns with my passion for technical excellence. I am excited to bring my backend engineering expertise and collaborative leadership style to support your distributed teams in building scalable, high-quality applications.
tailoring.motivation_short: Combining 5+ years of Java and Spring backend expertise with proven technical leadership, code reviews, and developer mentoring to drive impactful software delivery at Lightspeed.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! I am a Senior Java Developer and Team Lead with 5+ years of experience building scalable enterprise applications and mentoring developers. I would love to connect regarding the Team Lead, Software Development role at Lightspeed.
tailoring.email_subject: Application for Team Lead, Software Development (Backend) - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find my CV and cover letter attached for the Team Lead, Software Development (Backend) position at Lightspeed.

With over 5 years of experience building robust backend systems, REST APIs, and microservices in Java and Spring, alongside a strong background in technical mentoring, code reviews, and agile delivery, I am eager to support your engineering team.

I look forward to discussing how my background aligns with your needs.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
